reasons.pageMissing: A page in the list is no longer part of the scan.
reasons.parts: Parts must stay within the document and must not overlap.
reasons.rect: The selected area is too small or lies outside the page.
reasons.replacement: A find-and-replace rule in the name pattern is not a valid regular expression.
reasons.sameFile: Choose a different file; pages cannot be added from the document itself.
reasons.tooDeep: The PDF structure is nested too deeply to read safely.
reasons.tooLong: The password is too long to check.
reasons.unknownVoice: This voice is not known; refresh the voice list.
reasons.unsafeName: An attachment name points outside the chosen folder, so it was not saved.
reasons.untrustedHost: The voice download points to an untrusted address, so it was blocked.
reasons.voiceMissing: The chosen voice is not installed; install it from the voice list first.
reasons.voiceHelperMissing: The pointing model this voice needs is missing; connect to the internet and download or import the voice again.
reasons.trustMissing: This certificate is no longer among the trusted roots.
reasons.trustFileFormat: This file is neither a readable certificate nor a trust list. Choose a .cer, .crt, .pem or .der certificate, an EU trusted list or the EU list of trusted lists (.xml), or the Adobe trust list (.acrobatsecuritysettings).
reasons.trustListSignatureInvalid: This trust list's signature does not match its content, so the file was changed after signing. Nothing was added.
reasons.trustListUnverified: This trust list's signer is not confirmed. Review it and tick the confirmation to add it anyway.
reasons.trustListChanged: The file changed after it was reviewed. Add it again to review the new content.
reasons.trustListEmpty: This trust list has no active qualified provider of certificates or timestamps, so nothing was added.
reasons.translationPairMissing: A language this translation needs is not installed. Download it below.
reasons.translationPackageInvalid: The translation model package is damaged or not supported, so it was not installed.
reasons.unknownTranslationModel: This translation model is not known; refresh the model list.
reasons.translationChecksumMismatch: The downloaded translation model did not match its published checksum and was discarded. Try the download again.
reasons.translationDownloadTooLarge: The translation model download was larger than expected, so it was stopped.
reasons.translationUntrustedHost: The translation model download points to an untrusted address, so it was blocked.
reasons.translationModelExists: A model for this language pair is already installed. Remove it first to import another one.
reasons.translationPackageTooLarge: The model package is larger than {{limitMb}} MB, so it was not imported.
reasons.emptyReply: The reply is empty; write some text first.
reasons.notAComment: This entry cannot be answered: it is a status mark, a link or a form field rather than a comment.
reasons.commentNotFound: The comment is no longer in the file; refresh the comment list.
reasons.unknownLayer: This layer is not in the document any more; read the layers again.
reasons.svgDoctype: The SVG file declares a document type, which is not allowed for safety reasons.
reasons.notSvg: The file is not a readable SVG drawing.
reasons.svgTooLarge: The SVG file is larger than {{limitMb}} MB.
reasons.tableTooTall: The table is too tall for a page ({{height}} pt). Shorten the text or make the table wider.
reasons.fontUnreadable: The chosen font can't be read. Pick another font.
reasons.chartNoData: The chart has no numbers to draw.
reasons.pieNeedsPositive: A pie chart needs at least one value above zero in the first series.
reasons.scatterNeedsNumbers: A scatter chart needs numbers in the first column; “{{category}}” is not a number.
reasons.chartTooSmall: The chart is too small for its labels. Make it larger or the text smaller.
reasons.paperTooDense: The pattern is too dense for this page size. Choose a wider spacing.
reasons.questionTooTall: The question is too tall to fit on a page.
reasons.flowchartTooLarge: The flowchart is too large to fit on a page.
reasons.omrTooManyQuestions: Only {{capacity}} questions fit on one sheet with these settings.
reasons.omrLayoutUnknown: This sheet's layout code is not recognised; read the sheets again.
reasons.tooManyDocuments: Up to {{max}} documents can be open at once. Close one to open another.

about.statement: vivePDF brings everything you can do with a PDF — merge, split, compress, convert, OCR, redact, sign digitally, fill forms — into one desktop application that works the same on Windows, macOS and Linux.
about.statementSecondary: Your documents are never uploaded; every operation runs in the local engine on this computer.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: No internet connection required; files never leave the machine.

noTelemetry.title: No telemetry
noTelemetry.description: No usage data, identifiers or crash reports are collected.

free.title: Free
free.description: Every tool is included; there are no paid tiers, accounts or limits.

privacy.intro: vivePDF collects no personal data. Below is when the app touches the network and what it keeps on this computer.

network.documents: Documents, passwords and certificates never leave this computer.
network.updates: Checking for updates only sends version metadata, and only when “check automatically” is on or you click Check (Settings › Updates).
network.voices: Voice models and OCR language packs download from huggingface.co or github.com only when you click Download.
network.contributors: The contributors list is fetched from api.github.com only when you press Refresh on the Credits tab.
network.webSearch: Web search and Google Lens open your browser with the selected text or picture.
network.timestamp: The one exception: if you enter a timestamp server address while signing, a signature digest is sent to that server.
network.reports: Bug reports are never sent automatically — they are copied, saved to a file you choose, or opened as a prefilled GitHub issue in your browser.
